analysis_role: Post-result single-taxon falsification of H2. Test whether bidirectional reversible present-niche transition-regime tracking requires any one taxon in the strict n>=10 East-Asian panel.

tests.directional_robustness: for every deletion, forward and reverse alignment must each be positive on all six accepted topologies
tests.secondary_exceptionality: report exact one-sided rank of the median bidirectional floor; <=0.05 is descriptive secondary robustness

decision.bidirectional_direction_not_single_taxon: all nine deletion panels retain forward and reverse positivity on all six topologies
decision.bidirectional_direction_depends_on_taxon: at least one deletion loses forward or reverse positivity on at least one topology

claim_boundary: This is a post-result sensitivity analysis of H2, not independent replication.
The primary robustness target is directional persistence, not exact <=0.05 in every reduced finite-map panel.
Failure of exact <=0.05 after deletion may reflect reduced finite-map resolution as well as biological dependence.
No result establishes historical climate causation, selection, adaptation, or a mediator.
